name: Mean reversion
summary: Buys large, liquid stocks after a sharp short-term drop inside an uptrend, and sells into the bounce — usually within a week.

expected.config: 15 large US stocks above their 200-day average; RSI(2) < 10 in, > 70 out; next-open fills
expected.sizing: $6,000 fixed lots, 6 slots, in a $100,000 book
expected.costs: None modelled: commission-free; the next-open fill is the live model
caveats: Fixed $6,000 lots keep about a fifth of the book working; the live book sizes at the account ÷ 6
Today's names tested back to 2006: survivors by construction

steps.label: Universe
steps.title: Large US stocks
steps.text: Only while the stock sits above its 200-day average

steps.label: Entry
steps.title: Buy after a sharp drop
steps.text: RSI(2) closes under 10 → a buy limit 1% over the close, good for the next session; the lowest RSI first when signals outnumber slots

steps.label: Protect
steps.title: A stop rests at the broker
steps.text: 8% under the buy price — never lowered

steps.label: Exit
steps.title: Sell into the bounce
steps.text: RSI(2) closes over 70 → sold at the next open, underwater too; the stop or a −8% / +20% backstop otherwise. No time stop; held through earnings

sizing: Each position is the account value ÷ 6, at most 5 open.

attention.title: Evening run failed Mon 17:45
attention.detail: The broker timed out; the retry at 18:15 ran

review.label: System review
review.last_note: The rules were written down as v2.0. 16 trades scored, 15 followed the plan: too few for a verdict on the edge.

gates.label: Regime
gates.title: No new entries risk-off
gates.text: While SPY is under its 200-day average no entry is placed; exits and stops still run

gates.label: Daily loss
gates.title: Buying stops after a $40 day
gates.text: Once the day's realized loss reaches $40 no new buy is placed until tomorrow

gates.label: Caps
gates.title: Five lots, $1,000 an order
gates.text: At most 5 open lots, $1,000 per order, 10 orders and 6 decisions a day

gates.label: Kill file
gates.title: One file halts all new risk
gates.text: A kill file, placed from the phone too, stops every new order; open lots keep their stops

adherence.note: Each trade is judged against the rules in force when it was entered. Before the system placed the entries, a hand entry was how the rules were run; after that, a hand entry or exit is a deviation. A scored verdict is the desk's own, never recomputed here.
